text:
maria: Security advisory: our artifact scanner found multiple long-lived service account keys (GCP) in projects used by infra automation. Cloud provider is deprecating long-lived keys next quarter. We need an org-wide rotation + move to workload identity / short-lived keys.

sec-bot: Scan summary: 9 active keys >90 days, 3 in prod projects: proj-data-pipelines, proj-batch, proj-deploy. Report: gs://redwood-sec/reports/gcp-sa-keys-1955000000.json

oscar: Plan proposal: 1) create replacement SA with workload-identity binding 2) update runners to use token exchange 3) revoke old keys after verification. Canary in proj-data-pipelines.

infra: Quick note  some third-party integrations still only accept JSON key files. We'll need to list those and either use short-lived signed tokens or request vendor support.

samuel: Timeline: non-prod rotations within 48h, prod schedule over 7 days with daily canaries. Owners please ack and list any blockers.

maria: Owners: add owner tag to ticket SEC-2026-1094 and confirm by EOD. We'll also add a CI gate to refuse commits with new long-lived key files.

sec-bot: Action created: rotation-runbook.md attached to ticket. Follow-up scan scheduled in 24h.
